translation: In cold damage, the cold is received from outside, so one must first resolve it through sweating; dispersing the pathogen with acrid-warm is correct.
Cold inhaled through the mouth and nose is a yin disease of cold stroke; treatment should warm the interior and be applied according to the signs of the three yin.
As for summerheat disease, there are very few dedicated formulas, all because the ancients were brief on summerheat and detailed on cold.
